widgets_values:
subject_definitions: 
<Subject 1> is the individual whose visual identity, facial features, hairstyle, body build, and attire are strictly derived from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the individual whose visual identity, facial features, hairstyle, body build, and attire are strictly derived from <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the individual whose visual identity, facial features, hairstyle, body build, and attire are strictly derived from <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is the individual whose visual identity, facial features, hairstyle, body build, and attire are strictly derived from <Picture 4>.
<Video 1> is the source video providing the scene environment, camera motion, perspective, and lighting. It contains color-tinted inverted-color masks (red, green, blue, and yellow) that designate the exact spatial coordinates, pose, scale, and movement bounds for each subject.

summary:
[video inpainting + multi-subject replacement + reference synthesis] The target video synthesizes:
<Subject 1> (from <Picture 1>) into the red-tinted inverted masked area.
<Subject 2> (from <Picture 2>) into the green-tinted inverted masked area.
<Subject 3> (from <Picture 3>) into the blue-tinted inverted masked area.
<Subject 4> (from <Picture 4>) into the yellow-tinted inverted masked area.
All masks are completely eliminated and replaced by their respective subjects, seamlessly integrating into the environment, matching the pose, position, scale, lighting, and camera motion of <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, facial anatomy, hair, and wardrobe originate entirely from <Picture 1>, replacing the red-tinted mask.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, facial anatomy, hair, and wardrobe originate entirely from <Picture 2>, replacing the green-tinted mask.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, facial anatomy, hair, and wardrobe originate entirely from <Picture 3>, replacing the blue-tinted mask.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, facial anatomy, hair, and wardrobe originate entirely from <Picture 4>, replacing the yellow-tinted mask.
<Video 1>: background_preserved - all non-masked surroundings, camera trajectory, depth of field, and ambient lighting are retained 1:1.

detailed_description:
The target video matches the cinematography, camera motion, frame rate, lens characteristics, and color grading of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1]
<Subject 1>,
<Subject 2>,
<Subject 3>,
<Subject 4>
are synthesized precisely within their respective red, green, blue, and yellow inverted mask footprints in <Video 1> from the very first frame through the final frame. Each mask functions as the exact spatial footprint, pose guide, and scale reference for its assigned subject. Seamless edge blending, ambient light wrap, contact shadows, and realistic occlusion ensure natural integration with the surrounding unmasked background, leaving no residual tinted or inverted borders or artifacts.

overall_soundscape:
Complete ambient silence. No dialogue, no speech, no vocals.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
